name: RLE4 Compression
definition: A compression algorithm that converts a 3D voxel grid (stored as bit-packed voxels and color bits) into a sparse Run-Length Encoded (RLE) structure called Map4. It processes the volume slice-by-slice (XZ planes) and encodes runs of empty space (skip) and occupied space (solid) along the Y-axis.
summary: RLE4 Compression converts dense 3D voxel grids into sparse Map4 structures using fixed 16-bit words to preserve per-voxel material and intensity data, unlike binary RLE encoding.
